name: @contractspec/lib.ai-agent

hlido_opinion.headline: Strong coding assistant for contract specifications — reliable but lacks extensive documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @contractspec/lib.ai-agent offers a robust solution for developers working with contract specifications, showcasing a high score of 90 in our evaluation. Its capabilities in parsing and generating contract-related code are commendable, making it a valuable tool for those in legal tech and compliance. However, it does exhibit a weakness in the availability of comprehensive documentation, which could hinder new users from fully leveraging its features. Overall, it stands out as a dependable choice for coding professionals, albeit with room for improvement in user guidance.

tier_rationale: STEADY (90) due to its strong performance in contract specification tasks and a solid user base. It remains not VITAL because the lack of extensive documentation may limit its accessibility for new users. A more comprehensive support structure could elevate its standing.
